description: Returns the financial history of a German company from its filed annual accounts, one row per fiscal year: Bilanzsumme (total assets), Eigenkapital (equity), Jahresüberschuss (net income), Umsatz (revenue), Mitarbeiter (employees). Intended for requests where the user asks about revenue, equity, profit or headcount of a company over the years. Small companies may legally omit revenue; NULL means the figure was not published (not zero). Example user questions: 'What were the revenues of K1101_HRB52093 (HRB 52093, Amtsgericht Hamburg) in 2022?', 'Show me the equity history of this company'. Whether the company is still active is answered by check_company_status.

from_year.description: Oldest fiscal year to include (e.g. 2018). Optional.

register.description: company_number_norm — the unique register key for a German company. Format: {CourtLetter}{4digits}_{HRB|HRA|PR|GnR|VR}{Nummer}, Example: 'K1101_HRB52093' is HRB 52093 at Amtsgericht Hamburg (court code K1101). Court codes are not derivable from city names or initials; the key comes from find_company (register number + court, EUID, LEI, VAT ID) or from an earlier firm tool result. Input that is not a key (e.g. 'HRB 52093 Hamburg') is resolved the same way as in find_company; a well-formed key that belongs to no company is answered 'not found' (usually a wrong court code).

to_year.description: Most recent fiscal year to include (e.g. 2023). Optional.

name: get_company_financials
title: Bilanzzahlen einer Firma abrufen
